تستلذوا (form X)
# تَسْتَلِذُّوا (tastaliḏḏū) /tas.ta.lið.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# تُسْتَلَذُّوا (tustalaḏḏū) /tus.ta.lað.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
